pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: A direct-to-consumer brand runs a weekly email newsletter and a paid social ad program. They use a third-party customer data platform — a tool that centralizes customer data from multiple sources — to manage audience segments. They want to implement AI-driven personalization so that each customer receives email content and ad creative tailored to their individual predicted behavior. Walk me through how you would architect this personalization system: what data inputs you'd use, how you'd handle the fact that many customers interact across both email and paid social but can't always be matched to a single identity, and how you'd measure whether the personalization is actually working given that cookies are increasingly unreliable for tracking.
